markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Bust
markers.note: A marble bust pours coffee. Nobody in the city finds this remarkable. +Stamina.

markers.name: INT_The_Complaining_Door
markers.note: Locked, and it explains at length exactly why, and whose fault it is.

markers.name: INT_Staircase_to_Nowhere
markers.note: Ends in open air two storeys up.

markers.name: INT_The_Payphone
markers.note: Rings whenever a player walks past. Someone is on the line and knows your name.

markers.name: INT_The_Puddle
markers.note: Reflects a version of this street that is on fire. Yours is not.

markers.name: INT_The_Chair_That_Waits
markers.note: Moves a little closer whenever no player is looking at it.

markers.name: INT_The_Mailbox
markers.note: Holds a note another player left in this reality.

markers.name: INT_The_Loud_Painting
markers.note: Plays music, audible only within two metres of it.

markers.name: INT_The_Chandelier
markers.note: Swings to point at the nearest player.

markers.name: INT_The_Bureaucrat_s_Desk
markers.note: Stamping the form moves a wall somewhere else in the district.

markers.name: INT_The_Elevator
markers.note: Six buttons. Four go to floors.

markers.name: INT_Building_That_Breathes
markers.note: The facade expands and contracts. Warm to the touch.

markers.name: INT_The_Suggestion_Box
markers.note: Whatever you write shows up somewhere in the city later.

markers.name: INT_Traffic_Light_Choir
markers.note: Three lights, singing in harmony. They change key when a car passes.

markers.name: INT_The_Fountain
markers.note: Give it an item, get a different one back. Rarity is roughly preserved.

markers.name: INT_Reality_Weapon_Cache
markers.note: Contains the Gravity Gun (Reality class) behind a two-player lock.

markers.name: INT_The_Eye_of_Reality
markers.note: Legendary artifact. Origin: Reality 07. Status: unknown.
